scams.name: Honey Trap Bar Scam
scams.avoidance: Never follow strangers to bars they choose — pick your own or go to established ruin bars Check prices before ordering anything and see a written menu If you're handed a massive bill, know that many victims have successfully refused to pay and left — call the police if needed
scams.location: Váci Street, ruin bar district (Kazinczy Street area)

scams.name: Taxi Price Gouging
scams.avoidance: Only use Bolt (most popular app in Budapest) or licensed taxi companies like City Taxi Never get into an unmarked taxi Fares from airport to city center should be around 7,000-9,000 HUF
scams.location: Budapest airport, tourist areas, nightlife districts

scams.name: ATM Currency Conversion Trap (DCC)
scams.avoidance: Always choose to pay/withdraw in local currency (Hungarian Forints) Use ATMs attached to actual banks rather than standalone machines Decline DCC at every ATM and card terminal in Hungary

scams.name: Restaurant Bill Inflation
scams.avoidance: Ask to see a full menu with prices before sitting down Send back any food you didn't order before touching it Ask for itemized receipt and compare to menu prices before paying
scams.location: Tourist restaurants near Great Market Hall, thermal baths

scams.name: Fake Transport Pass Online
scams.avoidance: Only buy BKK passes from official BKK apps, official website, or station ticket offices Check the URL carefully — official site is bkk.hu If the deal seems too cheap to be real, it almost certainly is

scams.name: Friendly Stranger Chess Game Hustle
scams.avoidance: Only play games with strangers in formal public settings Never bet money in informal street games Enjoy watching chess in the park but decline to play for money
